requires.label: Residency required for non-emergent services
requires.quote: Financial assistance shall be provided to patients who meet program qualifications and reside within one of Intermountain Health’s service areas. Financial assistance shall be provided, without discrimination, to patients from outside the Intermountain Health services areas, who otherwise qualify for the program, and who present with an urgent, emergent, or life-threatening condition.

rules.label: Fully Discounted (No Charge) Care
rules.quote: Fully Discounted (No Charge) Care: For eligible services, fully Discounted Care will be provided to a patient, or patient’s Guarantor, meeting the following criteria: 1. Uninsured and Underinsured patients meeting other eligibility criteria and with annual family incomes not in excess of 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, and 2. All other payment options have been exhausted for the patient including private coverage, federal, state and local medical assistance programs, and other forms of assistance provided by third parties, unless prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.

rules.label: Discounted Care
rules.quote: Discounted Care: For eligible services, Discounted Care will be provided to a patient, or patient’s Guarantor meeting the following criteria: • Uninsured and underinsured patients meeting other eligibility criteria and whose annualized family incomes are in excess of 250% but less than or equal to 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, and • All other payment options have been exhausted for the patient including private coverage, federal, state and local medical assistance programs, and other forms of assistance provided by third parties.

rules.label: Medical Hardship
rules.quote: For eligible services, Discounted Care will be provided to a patient, or patient’s Guarantor, meeting the following criteria: 1. Patient, or patient’s Guarantor, has annual family income in excess of 500% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines 2. Patient, or patient’s Guarantor, has exhausted all other payment options including private coverage, federal, state and local medical assistance programs, and other forms of assistance provided by third parties; and 3. The out-of-pocket, patient obligations resulting from medical services provided by Intermountain Health providers exceed 25% of annual family income.

payment_plan.quote: Payment Plans: A reasonable payment plan will be established between Intermountain Health and the patient, or patient guarantor, for any balance remaining after the cost of care has been discounted under the financial assistance policy.

notes: The policy states that financial assistance determinations will be made after all efforts to qualify the patient for other public or private programs have been exhausted, which is modeled via the 'applied_public_programs' requirement in each rule.
The policy mentions that patients may be denied financial assistance if they do not cooperate in applying for programs they may pay for, which is captured in the 'requires' section for cooperation.
The policy specifies that emergency services are covered regardless of residency status, which is reflected in the 'req_residency_non_emergent' rule requiring residency only for non-emergent care.
The policy defines 'Medically Necessary' as per Medicare, and limits financial assistance to such services, which is captured in 'req_medically_necessary_services'.
The policy includes a sliding scale for medical hardship but does not specify exact discount percentages, hence 'discount_pct' is null for that rule.
The policy references the Patient Discount Policy for uninsured discounts but does not state a percentage, hence 'discount_pct' is null for the uninsured discount rule.
The policy does not specify a maximum percentage of monthly income or minimum monthly dollar amount for payment plans, so those fields are null.
The policy does not state when extraordinary collection actions (ECA) may begin, so 'eca_not_before' is empty.
The policy does not specify a minimum number of months for payment plans, so 'max_months' is null.
